\section{\texttt{build\_agent}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.factory.build_agent}\index{Functions!build\_agent}

Construct a fully wired feedback insight agent.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
build_agent(settings: Settings, *, telemetry: Telemetry | None = None) -> FeedbackInsightAgent
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{settings}] \texttt{Settings}, required.
  \item[\texttt{telemetry}] \texttt{Telemetry \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{FeedbackInsightAgent}
\apifield{Details}When no telemetry emitter is supplied, one is built from the settings (a no-op unless telemetry is enabled via the environment). The agent is equipped with the default local tool registry built over the indexed feedback chunks.
